handback.title: Dokima's own problems file themselves into Dokima's repo
handback.summary: Problems that are Dokima's fault, and its failed runs, on a trial repo file themselves into Dokima's repo.
handback.user_story: When Dokima misbehaves on another repo, the owner finds one issue for it in Dokima's repo.

acceptance_criteria.text: When the settings name an upstream repo, a problem tagged as Dokima's fault is filed there.

edge_cases.case: With no upstream repo set, the default, a tagged problem stays in the repo itself.
A problem that is the repo's own stays in the repo itself.

acceptance_criteria.text: When a problem is filed upstream, the record on the repo's issue links to the upstream issue.
acceptance_criteria.words: Traceability runs the other way: the repo's issue links to the upstream one.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: One link on one filing; repeats are criterion 4.

acceptance_criteria.text: Every agent's instructions say how to judge and tag a problem as Dokima's, the repo's own, or unclear.
acceptance_criteria.words: each problem is first judged as Dokima's (its workflows, code, prompts, settings or install) or the repo's own (its code or its tests)
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: Fixed prompt text, checked for every role.

acceptance_criteria.text: When the same tagged problem is raised again, it becomes a comment on the upstream issue, never a second issue.
acceptance_criteria.words: Repeats become comments on the existing upstream issue, never a second issue.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: A first filing is proved by criterion 1.

acceptance_criteria.text: When a shared workflow's job fails, the upstream repo gets an issue naming that workflow and job.
acceptance_criteria.words: A final step in each shared workflow files the failure upstream

edge_cases.case: With no upstream repo set, a failure files nothing and the step passes.

acceptance_criteria.text: Every shared workflow job, except the two test checks and the review relay, ends by filing its failure upstream.
acceptance_criteria.words: leave `reviews.yml` out of that test, as 745.6 already says. Relay failures are not filed upstream.

edge_cases.case: A failed test check files nothing upstream, even if its failure step runs.

acceptance_criteria.text: When the same failure happens twice, the upstream repo holds one issue with two comments.
acceptance_criteria.words: forcing the same Dokima-caused failure twice on the trial repo yields one upstream issue with two linked comments

edge_cases.case: A different job's failure opens its own upstream issue.

acceptance_criteria.text: When an agent cannot tell whose fault a problem is, it stays in the repo, its issue saying so.
acceptance_criteria.words: When it cannot tell, it says so on the repo's issue and files nothing upstream.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: One tag, one place; the no-upstream default is under criterion 1.

acceptance_criteria.text: Nothing filed upstream names or links the private repo, its issues or their words.
acceptance_criteria.words: the upstream problem never names or links the private repo, since even its name is the repo's own
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: One test checks problems, repeats and failures together.

non_functional.text: Filing upstream mints its key from the App's existing key, with no new secret.
non_functional.why: The App's key already covers every repo it is installed on.
